title: Normalization: quotient by G-bar vs. the actual moduli stratum not reconciled

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Location:** Lemma 2.2 final paragraph; Definition 3.1 commentary.

The solution equates the moduli stratum with $\operatorname{Spec}R=\mathbb A^n/\!\!/\bar G$, 'generically one-to-one'. But the isomorphism class is the orbit of the branch tuple under the full admissible $\mathrm{PGL}_2$-normalization group $\Gamma$, which is used to fix the model BEFORE $\bar G$ acts. The claim that after normalization exactly the finite $\bar G$ remains and the residual quotient maps generically one-to-one onto the stratum is asserted, not proved, for general strata.

**Fix:** give an explicit dimension count ($\dim\mathbb A^n-\dim\bar G$ vs. $\dim\mathcal S=r-3$) and a generic-stabilizer-triviality argument, accounting explicitly for the $\mathrm{PGL}_2$ normalization.
